description: Advisory issuer registry. Entries are facts used to cross-check evidence (e.g. whether a QR domain matches a known issuer's verification domain). The registry NEVER changes the ML feature vector and never produces verdicts by itself. Unknown issuers are treated as unverified, not as fraud. Each entry may optionally declare a documented programmatic verification endpoint; only such endpoints are ever contacted by the verification layer.
